vulnerable_statements.reason: Several SCMI protocols can share the same scmi_chan_info, so this idr callback can run more than once on the same cinfo. The first call sets cinfo->transport_info to NULL. On a later call, channel is NULL, and the function never checks for that.

If transport_info was already cleared by an earlier free, channel is NULL and list_del dereferences an invalid pointer derived from NULL. The later reads of channel->tee_session and channel->tee_shm, and the write to channel->cinfo, also use the NULL pointer. This can oops the kernel during teardown.

suggested_fix: Right after reading cinfo->transport_info, return early if channel is NULL (for example 'if (!channel) return 0;'). This covers a shared channel that an earlier call already freed and makes the free routine safe to call more than once.
